title: Perovskite quantum dot@MOF heterostructures: highly efficient and stable visible-light photocatalysts
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE01602A, Review Article
Mohamed Abu Shuheil, Ahmed Aldulaimi, Subhashree Ray, Talal Aziz Qassem, Gunjan Garg, Renu Sharma, Dilbar Urazbaeva, Sabokhat Sadikova, Sharmin Smaeilpour
Perovskite quantum dots confined in a MOF-derived N-doped carbon framework create highly active, stable catalytic sites, delivering efficient bifunctional HER and ORR performance through synergistic electronic and structural effects.
